Public (Nasdaq: XE, CIK 2088896) since 2026-04-24; operating entity X-Energy Reactor Company, LLC (XERC), DOE recipient "X ENERGY, LLC". PRIMARY EVIDENCE = the SEC 424B4 prospectus dated 2026-04-23 (snapshot db86c83f, filed 2026-04-27) and USAspending JSON. P2 (x-energy.com is ToS-forbidden): no x-energy.com page is used as evidence. The Wayback Machine (web.archive.org) refused connections from this host during the session, so Wayback copies of the x-energy.com releases (Series C $235M 2022, Amazon 2024, Dow, IPO pricing) could not be archived; round amounts here come from the SEC prospectus alone and investor lists are therefore incomplete (only participants named in the prospectus). Not recorded for lack of an evidenced amount/date: Series A/A-1/B rounds, Series C (issued 2022-23; the prospectus only states the 2023-12-05 conversion of C-1 Notes, the 2024-10-11 conversion of $98.0M of C-2 Notes into Series C units and 2025-09-30 conversion of the remaining $18.4M, i.e. debt conversions), 2023 Bridge Loan from Ares Acquisition Holdings ($10.0M initial draw Oct 2023, further draws $14.2M and $25.8M, settled $53.5M), Live Oak credit facility (settled 2024), Bank of New York facility ($20.2M settled Oct 2024), and SPV Form D filings (Ares X-Energy Co-Invest LP $40.55M 2024-10-09; SCP X-Energy Holdco $19.2M then $29.9M; Lightcone Series D SPV $19.0M 2026-02-05; X-Energy Management LLC $22.8M 2025-07-01, see docs/survey/probes/edgar.md). No ATM program or follow-on offering found in the EDGAR submissions list up to 2026-09-04 (only IPO, S-8, 10-Qs, 8-Ks, 13Gs). DISCREPANCY KEPT OPEN: the prospectus says X-energy was awarded "an initial $1.2 billion" under ARDP (cooperative agreement DE-NE0009040: 50/50 cost share of $2.4 billion eligible costs, $1.2B reimbursement), while USAspending shows total_obligation $921,717,024 (obligated to date), non_federal_funding $1,231,504,986.50, total_funding $2,153,222,010.50 and total_account_obligation $1,083,615,571.33 for the same award. They are separate events in round_group ardp-xe100-demo and must not be summed; obligations are cumulative and revised by modification. A DOE-side announcement page was not fetched (energy.gov origin snapshot not taken), so the DOE-announced figure is evidenced via the SEC prospectus. NOTE ipo-2026 announced_on is the prospectus date; ARK Investment Management only "indicated an interest" in up to $105.0M so no participant amount is given. NOTE triso-x-48c-2024: the month (March 2024) is stated but not the day; 2024-03-01 is a placeholder; it is a tax credit (instrument other), not cash. NOTE series-d-2025: investor names not stated in the prospectus passage; Jane Street Global Trading appears only as an Original Equity Owner.
 VERIFIER (2026-10-05): ARDP follows the Kairos convention: the DOE $1.2B reimbursement commitment is a ceiling (up_to, not all obligated), the USAspending obligation $921.7M is the counted new_money figure (obligated_usd 921.7M, outlays 581.4M; total_account_obligation $1.08B differs and is not used). The 48C $150M is a tax credit not yet realised (applies on placement in service), now a ceiling, never cash. ARK removed as IPO participant: a non-binding indication of interest is not evidence of purchase. IPO: the Q2 2026 10-Q says the over-allotment was exercised (about 50.9M shares at $23.00, about $1.1B net); the event keeps the stated base-deal gross $1,017,857,157, so the counted IPO amount understates gross proceeds by about $153M (6,638,198 option shares x $23, computed, not stated). Series C-1 $626.5M is cash only; the $20.0M Amazon note converted separately, so no double count.
